<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Split from #60823: replaces the vendored MiniMax-M3 config and ports the MiniMax-M3 code to the upstream Transformers `MiniMaxM3VLConfig` schema.

Related PRs:
- **#60823:** the larger unvendoring PR this is split from; MiniMax-M3 has been dropped from it.
- **#61392:** the same split for DeepSeek-V4.

## Claims

- Registers upstream `MiniMaxM3VLConfig` for `minimax_m3_vl` in `_CONFIG_REGISTRY`, because the hub remote code uses the old schema.
- `vllm/transformers_utils/configs/minimax_m3.py` shrinks to `MiniMaxM3MTPConfig`, a subclass of upstream `MiniMaxM3VLTextConfig` for standalone MTP checkpoints (`model_type: "minimax_m3_mtp"`). These copy the main model's 60-entry per-layer lists, which upstream rejects for a 1-layer config, so the subclass keeps the leading entries the MTP layer reads. No public checkpoint uses this format, but private ones may.
- The NVIDIA and AMD model code, indexers and vision tower read the upstream fields:
  - `layer_types` / `mlp_layer_types` replace `sparse_attention_config["sparse_attention_freq"]` / `moe_layer_freq`.
  - `index_*` fields replace the rest of `sparse_attention_config`.
  - `rope_parameters` replaces `rope_theta` / `partial_rotary_factor` / `rope_scaling`.
  - The vision tower reads `spatial_merge_size` / `temporal_patch_size` directly.
- Upstream reports `hidden_act="silu"` and drops `swiglu_beta`, so the `swigluoai` check is removed and beta is fixed at 1.0, the value in every checkpoint and in the upstream reference model. `sparse_init_block` and `sparse_score_type` fall back to the indexer's defaults (`0`, `"max"`), which also match every checkpoint.
- **Fix:** re-saved checkpoints in the upstream schema (e.g. `lukealonso/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4`) failed with "Unsupported activation: silu"; they now build.
- No numerics change: greedy outputs are bit-identical to `main`, and GSM8k and GPQA Diamond match.
- Open MiniMax-M3 PRs that add reads of the old field names will need a rebase once this lands: #60930, #61370, #57909, #59653, #57832, #60528.

## Validation

`nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4` on 8x B200, `main` (`b965ee564d`) on GPUs 0-3 vs this branch on GPUs 4-7, TP4 each, `transformers` 5.19.0, FlashInfer autotuning off.

| Check | `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8k, 5-shot, 1319 questions, 2 runs | 0.875, 0.870 | 0.870, 0.871 |
| GPQA Diamond, 8 repeats | 0.686 | 0.691 |
| Greedy decode, 5 prompts (up to ~56k chars) x 64 tokens | | bit-identical logprobs |

Config and meta-device model dumps with the `transformers-upgrade` skill's scripts, for `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3`, `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8`, `nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4` and `amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4`: 0 diffs in parameters and module attributes, for both the main model and the MTP draft (`--speculative-config '{"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 1}'`), including a draft loaded from a synthetic standalone MTP checkpoint in the old schema. `lukealonso/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4` goes from the error above to building. The config diffs are only the schema renames. MTP was not served: no public MiniMax-M3 checkpoint ships MTP weights. The ROCm path was not served either; it is covered by the meta-device build and `test_fused_shared_expert.py`, which builds the AMD `MiniMaxM3Model`.

```bash
vllm serve nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 --trust-remote-code --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --max-model-len 65536 --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
  --kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune": false}'
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port <port> --num-shots 5 --max-tokens 512
OPENAI_API_KEY=EMPTY python tests/evals/gpt_oss/run_gpqa_eval.py --model nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 \
  --reasoning-effort high --base-url http://localhost:<port>/v1 --n-threads 128 --max-output-tokens 32768
```

```bash
pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m3.py tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py
# main: 1 failed (test_fmha_sm100_indexer_matches_reference), 223 passed; this PR: 224 passed
pytest tests/transformers_utils/test_minimax_m3_config.py  # 1 passed
pytest tests/transformers_utils tests/config tests/models/test_registry.py tests/test_config.py
# main and this PR: the same 11 failed, 1237 passed (GPUs hidden for this run)
```
